entities.name: Quotations from Chairman Mao Tse-tung
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: The Quotations from Chairman Mao Tse-tung are a collection of selected statements from speeches and writings by Mao Zedong, published in 1964. This compilation showcases Mao's ideological and political thought, reflecting his vision for a socialist China and his role as a leader of the Chinese Communist Party. The Quotations contain 150 key statements, many of which have become iconic in Chinese history, and provide insight into Mao's leadership style and strategic thinking. The publication of the Quotations marked a significant moment in the Cultural Revolution, solidifying Mao's position as a symbol of the revolution and its ideology. The collection has had a lasting impact on Chinese politics, education, and culture, with many of its statements still widely referenced and debated today.
